description: Returns one CMBS trust (deal) by slug or name fragment: balance and distress, parties (master and special servicer, directing certificateholder, operating advisor, trustee), every certificate class with CUSIP, coupon, balance, losses and credit support, and liquidated loans with loss severity. Use list_trusts to find a trust by name; use search_loans with trust set to a slug for the trust's loans.

trust.description: Trust slug like "benchmark-2018-b8" or a name fragment like "BANK 2019-BNK16"

name: get_trust

outputSchema.description: Every field with its unit and codes, in full: https://cmbs.news/openapi.json (operation getTrust). Money in US dollars; a rate, occupancy or share is a fraction of 1 (0.0475 is 4.75%) unless it says percent; DSCR is a multiple; dates YYYY-MM-DD.

argumentNote.description: Sent when an argument was renamed, read in another form or left out because it could not be used: says which and how.

callsLeft.description: Without a key: calls left today on the free allowance, this one counted. Not sent with a Pro or Team key.

candidates.description: On a found: false answer: the closest real records, most likely first; empty when nothing is close.

items.description: One real record close to what was asked.

class.description: A certificate class: its class as the trust files it, e.g.

leftTheTrusts.description: A loan: true when it paid off or left the trusts, so its page shows its last figures.

slug.description: A loan: its slug, to pass to get_loan.

trust.description: A certificate class: the slug of its trust.

trustName.description: A certificate class: the name of its trust.

capped.description: True when the liquidations list was cut at the plan limit.

found.description: Present only when the trust asked for is not on file: false.

keyNote.description: Sent when the key given was a placeholder (such as YOUR_KEY): the call was answered as a call without a key, and this says why.

matchNote.description: Present when the request named no trust or text that fits several: says which trust was returned.

message.description: Why, in words: what was asked, why nothing matched, and what to do.

nextCall.description: On a found: false answer: the exact call to make next, as {tool, arguments}. An argument written in <angle brackets> is a template to fill in.

note.description: Present with capped: sentence stating the plan's list limit.

otherMatches.description: Up to 8 other trusts that fit the text sent.

trust.description: One trust: its row from the trust list plus parties, certificate classes and liquidated loans from its latest trustee report (10-D Exhibit 99.1).

bal.description: Outstanding balance of those notes, dollars (includes carried notes).

bonds.description: The trust's certificate classes from the report's distribution table, for the distribution in distributionDate.

carriedBal.description: Balance of those carried notes, dollars; included in bal, excluded from ssBal and dlqBal.

carriedN.description: Count of the trust's notes that its latest asset file leaves out and that are carried from an earlier file; present only when above zero.

cik.description: The trust's SEC CIK number, as a string without leading zeros.

distributionDate.description: Distribution date of that report (YYYY-MM-DD); null when none or not readable.

dlqBal.description: Balance of the trust's notes whose loan is delinquent (30+ days late or matured and not paid off), dollars; carried notes excluded.

filed.description: Date (YYYY-MM-DD) the trust's latest asset file (Form ABS-EE) was filed; for an older trust with no asset file, its 10-D.

liquidations.description: Loans the trust has liquidated, from the report's liquidated-loan history table, newest first; capped at the plan's list limit (25 free, 400 paid).

lossToDate.description: Sum of `loss` over all the trust's liquidation rows, rounded to whole dollars; 0 when none.

n.description: Count of the trust's notes (its pieces of loans) on file, including notes carried from an earlier asset file.

nightly.description: True on a trust picked up by the nightly refresh since the monthly build; such a trust has empty parties and bonds.

note.description: Present with nightly: fixed sentence saying parties, classes and losses come with the next monthly build.

parties.description: The firms the trustee report's front page names, by role.

partySource.description: Present when a party was taken from another SEC filing because the report does not settle it.

period.description: Latest reporting period end date among the trust's notes (YYYY-MM-DD).

special.description: The trust's own special servicer as its latest trustee report names it (same as parties.special at the monthly build); null when the report settles none or the trust was picked up by the nightly...

src.description: URL of that filing's index page on SEC EDGAR.

ssBal.description: Balance of the trust's notes whose loan is with the special servicer, dollars; carried notes excluded.

totalLiquidations.description: Count of all liquidation rows on file for the trust, before the list cap.

trusteeReport.description: URL of the trust's latest trustee report (10-D Exhibit 99.1) on SEC EDGAR; null when none is on file.

title: Get one CMBS trust
